svg.title: Seven loci and paired fly phenotypes
svg.desc: Original schematic trait comparisons at source map coordinates 0 16.5 48.5 57.5 67.0 75.5 and104.5. Locus spacing is schematic, not proportional. Aristae are branched head appendages; paired head views distinguish short versus long and maroon cinnabar brown versus red eyes. Dorsal flies distinguish body color and wing reduction; side views distinguish downward curved versus normal wings.
